The animal_pose_auditor's high low-confidence ratio (0.71) corroborates the Router's observation of 'melting' or lack of definition in the wrists and paws. The severity is moderate (2.5) because it affects the realism of the contact points but does not destroy the overall subject integrity. No catastrophic structural failures (extra limbs, impossible geometry) were detected.
